purpose: Test whether narrowing the V100 warm-preserving LoadLeast activation band to moderate current queue density retains spike gains while preventing deep-congestion sustained and pulse regressions.

accepted_window_diagnosis.harmful_E870_sustained_all_vs_q_lt_32: 22 accepted windows and 35 substitutions versus 4 accepted windows and 13 substitutions
accepted_window_diagnosis.harmful_E870_pulse_all_vs_q_lt_32: 44 accepted windows and 59 substitutions versus 10 accepted windows and 17 substitutions
accepted_window_diagnosis.beneficial_E871_sustained_all_vs_q_lt_32: 63 accepted windows and 78 substitutions versus 40 accepted windows and 54 substitutions
accepted_window_diagnosis.beneficial_E871_spike_all_vs_q_lt_32: 65 accepted windows and 102 substitutions versus 38 accepted windows and 64 substitutions
accepted_window_diagnosis.interpretation: Warm preservation removed one failure mode but still admitted many structural moves during deep congestion. Moderate-density activation is an outcome-blind current-state guard; the retained-window counts are diagnostic only and do not estimate counterfactual performance.

revealed_diagnosis.causal_limit: V100 does not identify the causal outcome of any individual accepted move. V101 therefore tests two frozen moderate-density bands on fresh seeds rather than deleting V100 rows or claiming replayed counterfactuals.

closed_alternatives.warm_only: closed because it failed throughput and QPR mean gates in all three V100 scenarios
closed_alternatives.substitution_caps: closed by V99 because cap1 and cap2 were both harmful in sustained load
closed_alternatives.scenario_or_burst_label_router: forbidden because workload labels are outside the online information boundary
closed_alternatives.completion_or_QPR_feedback: forbidden because completed-request outcomes and selection metrics are outside the online information boundary

allowed_online_inputs: current pending plus resident task count by node
current running warm-container membership for the player function on anchor and candidate nodes
frozen terminal-OCS or nonterminal-FaaSRank routed score and history

arms.queue_density_band: [8,24) for nonterminal players and [0,24) for terminal players
[8,32) for nonterminal players and [0,32) for terminal players

candidate_mechanism.player_order: retain the exact V94 SRPT-ready order
candidate_mechanism.warm_admissibility: candidate must be warm whenever the frozen anchor node is warm; cold-anchor substitutions retain exact V98 eligibility
candidate_mechanism.eligible_move: retain the exact V98 strictly-lower-projected-load and routed-score-nonworse rule
complete_initializer_acceptance: at least one warm-preserving structural substitution
candidate_mechanism.coordination_acceptance: retain the V94 dual window-safe Pareto guard and additionally require a nonworse complete-assignment LoadLeast score
candidate_mechanism.threshold_provenance: 24 is the conservative moderate-density guard and 32 is the binary midpoint of the frozen V100 upper bound 64; both are frozen before V101 implementation and fresh-seed input generation.

selection.throughput_gate_per_scenario: candidate three-seed mean is at least the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is nonnegative on at least two of three seeds
selection.qpr_gate_per_scenario_per_convention: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is strictly positive on at least two of three seeds
selection.E3_winner_requires: one candidate passes all three metrics in all three E3 scenarios
selection.multiple_passers: maximize the minimum relative mean QPR gain across scenarios and conventions, then maximize the minimum relative throughput change, then prefer the narrower 24 threshold, then arm_id
selection.frozen_E4_component: V97 v97-e4-load-guard64; no V101 E4 arm or result-dependent E4 reselection
selection.E3_pass_authorizes_only: a separately committed E926-E945 all-20-seed confirmation plan pairing the selected E3 profile with the already frozen V97 E4 profile
selection.failure_action: Freeze all 27 runs, keep every unopened seed untouched, do not replace seeds or selectively rerun scientific results, and return to mechanism diagnosis.
